accepted_review_changes.reference_navigation: Added explicit identification of coefficient m,n with PRZZInterface d,e and of the four headline audits with the four theorems audited at the end of WuProportion: dyadic_eventually, cumulative_eventually, strict_proportion, ratio_eventually_gt.
accepted_review_changes.url_copy_check: Verified the current PDF text and URI annotation both contain the ASCII tilde in https://people.math.ethz.ch/~kowalski/ik-ant-exp-sums.pdf; neither contains a substituted hyphen. The source coefficient support remains 1 <= n <= y.
accepted_review_changes.C1: Current pre-edit TeX already had tau=1/4000000, exponents -3/2000000 and -1/1600000, and public-loss exponents -21/16000000 and -7/16000000. Exact rational recomputation confirmed them. Changed typography only to scientific notation and digit-grouped fractions to prevent zero-count misreading.
accepted_review_changes.C2: The existing remainder already used (R theta)^(J+1)/(J+1)!, matching numerical_interval.py's order+1. Formula unchanged; added explicit distinction between derivative order j and truncation order J.
accepted_review_changes.C3: Added gcd(0,q)=q convention and explicitly included a=0 in the incomplete Weil input description.
accepted_review_changes.M1_M2: No changes: existing TeX already uses truncation exponent J+1 and coefficient support 1 <= n <= y.
accepted_review_changes.M3: Added large-rho trivial-bound split and absorption of an otherwise uniform rho^delta B_delta bound with delta=2epsilon/3; explicitly does not remove arbitrary rho-dependent implied constants or substitute for source correspondence.
accepted_review_changes.M4: Added published PRZZ journal/DOI citation, retaining the inspected arXiv v3 for theorem and page numbering.
accepted_review_changes.M5: Added Wu's 0.86957 on-line comparator and AF's 0.85838/0.86864 simple-and-on-line comparators. AF's results are unconditional, not premised on simple zeros; the cited AF v2 uses Remark 7.1. Wu's zeta-count denominator is compared asymptotically via Riemann-von Mangoldt. No Conrey Part II decimal is added without a separate source check.
accepted_review_changes.M6: Aligned coefficient indices m,n and zeta-series indices k,k-prime in the diagonal mk=nk-prime argument.
